activity_summary: Cuthbert called from a scrivener's in Cheapside. The Mayor's letter to the Council, against plays, came as hearsay from a Guildhall clerk. It names the Bankside and also Middlesex, which is his father's house and two miles of fields. His man could not swear the Theatre was named. You were to say nothing until the play was done.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Asked about James, and said nothing further until after the play.

entities.name: Cuthbert Burbage
entities.context: Named himself and Cheapside, gave the hearsay, and said he would come by five.

entities.name: James Burbage
entities.context: Not told yet. Cuthbert would rather he heard it after he had eaten.

quotes.speaker: cuthbert_burbage
quotes.text: Will? Cuthbert Burbage. From a scrivener's in Cheapside, and I'll be short.

quotes.speaker: cuthbert_burbage
quotes.text: And all of us. Play well. You may be doing it for the justices.
